summary: The food-detection scroll enters read.c:seffect_food_detection, whose consumed return depends on detect.c:food_detect. JavaScript records the read effect as unported and has no food_detect implementation, so the C food scent/map path and its input boundary diverge. Port the whole detect.c function and wire the scroll caller from source, including no-food, nearby-only, and map-display outcomes.

source.branch: food_detect chooses food or potion class from Confusion/cursed state, clears stale object marks, scans floor objects and monster inventories at and away from the hero, then either invokes strange_feeling, reports a nearby smell, or displays the detected map. It returns one only for nothing detected without stale map data. read.c:seffect_food_detection consumes that return and clears its scroll pointer so the caller does not use the already consumed object.
callers: read.c:seffect_food_detection calls detect.c:food_detect and consumes its integer return; read.c:seffects SCR_FOOD_DETECTION and SPE_DETECT_FOOD dispatch reach that wrapper from doread or spell.c:spelleffects. js/read.js:seffects currently records note_unported(read.c seffect_food_detection).
dependencies: detect.c:o_in, clear_stale_map, browse_map, map_redisplay, and object-detection presentation helpers have existing counterparts in js/detect.js; food_detect is absent.
The empty-result path uses strange_feeling and scroll consumption, while the map path changes screen state and waits for input; preserve the return contract across js/read.js seeffects.
The source scan includes floor and monster inventory objects; do not reduce the port to the selected floor-ration path.

evidence: Current saved challenges/evaluations/20260927175933-v9.json leaves 2 of 47 screens unmatched, first at segment 0 step 45 after reading a food-detection scroll. The later exercise RNG difference is downstream of the missing effect.

Upstream nethack-c/upstream/src/detect.c:food_detect lines 479-589 owns the scan, messages, map display, and return; read.c:seffect_food_detection lines 2046-2052 consumes its return. js/detect.js lacks food_detect but contains several required helpers.
